remarks: Seize the opportunity to own a meticulously maintained three-family property nestled in the highly sought-after Saugatuck area of Westport. This location is rich with amenities and attractions, including proximity to the Metro North train station, renowned local dining spots, and a variety of outdoor activities along the scenic Saugatuck River. This spacious property, ideally situated in Westport, presents an outstanding investment opportunity, particularly valuable given the current low housing inventory. Upon arrival, you'll discover three generously sized and fully self-sufficient units: two in the main building and one adjacent unit. Each unit features ample living space and plentiful storage. Modern appliances and ample counter space adorn the well-equipped kitchens, while the bedrooms ensure privacy and comfort. Don't let this chance slip by to own this multifamily property, offering residents the vibrant downtown atmosphere and all Westport's amenities.
